title: 第二十四章 情凝新大道 暗影布危棋第二十五章 幻域迷真心 情定破虚妄

幽深峡谷尘埃落定，漫天黑气尽数消散。
黑风獠怪、毒雾蛊怪、裂山岩怪三大拦路邪怪，在爱之力量与五象正道合力碾压之下，灰飞烟灭，连一丝残魂都未曾留存。
峡谷之内，被邪气腐蚀发黑的岩壁、枯萎的草木，在方才爆发的爱之伟力、草木生机、月华清辉、时序灵气的涤荡滋养下，悄然生出点点新绿。阴风止息，瘴气消融，久违的天光穿透云层，洒落谷底，映照着五道并肩而立的身影。
何年缓缓散去周身时序神光，指尖依旧残留着方才五道本源共振的余韵。他垂眸感受着体内悄然蜕变的道力，神色平静，眼底却藏着几分深沉的明悟。
经此一战，五人早已不再是简单的同道羁绊。何日与公孙离觉醒的爱之大道，以人间至情、生死相守为根基，完美融入时序、月华、骄阳、草木四道本源，补全了补天大道最缺失的人心温情。五象补天镇魔大阵不再只是攻防杀伐的战阵，更是有情有义、有守有护、有生有灭、阴阳圆满的终极正道阵法，攻防之力、续航之力、愈战之力尽数暴涨一个层级，真正踏入圆满大成之境。
何月收敛起月华柔光，银辉敛于周身，轻声感慨：“魔主以无情灭世为本，麾下众魔只懂杀伐、贪婪、怨恨、掠夺，永远不懂人间情爱、相守羁绊。今日爱之力量觉醒，便是天道注定正道不灭、魔界必败的征兆。”
花月初指尖拂过岩壁新生的嫩芽，翠绿灵息缓缓流转，笑意温润：“草木尚懂相依共生，何况于人。情爱不是凡尘枷锁，是天地孕育的至高生机，可破死寂，可克寂灭，可安人心，可定乾坤。”
何日与公孙离十指紧扣，掌心正阳暖意与花间柔韵依旧共振不息。少年的骄阳金光褪去了血战的凛冽锋芒，多了一层温柔炽烈的柔光；少女的伞影灵韵少了几分孤柔，多了一往无前的决绝力量。二人相视一眼，无需多言，眼底的爱意与信任，已然胜过千言万语。这份觉醒的爱之大道，不再是一时爆发的临时力量，而是深深烙印在神魂本源之中，往后每一次并肩作战，都会化作源源不断的助力。
“有爱同行，万劫不惧。”何日朗声开口，语气笃定坚定，“往后无论魔界再来何等强敌，我与阿离，必以爱火燃尽邪祟，护同伴周全，护天道安宁。”
公孙离轻轻颔首，眉眼温柔，声线却带着一往无前的果敢：“此生执伞伴骄阳，魔劫风雨共相随。”
四人相视，皆由衷欣慰。接连几场血战，数次绝境突围，不仅未让众人道心受损、情谊离散，反倒一次次淬炼羁绊，觉醒全新大道，正道气运节节攀升，距离补天救世的终极目标，愈发靠近。
短暂休整片刻，众人调息完毕，修复此战损耗的神力。何年抬手感应天地时序气机，梳理剩余玉璧残片的大致方位，沉声道：“三邪虽灭，不过是魔主试探性的拦路棋子。今日我们觉醒爱之大道、阵法圆满大成，此事瞬息间便会传入魔界。魔主生性阴狠多疑，忌惮我们愈发强盛的正道气运，绝不会坐视我们继续寻访残璧，必然会布下更凶险、更阴诡的杀局。”
“我们不可在此久留，即刻启程，继续向西南前行，一边休整蓄力，一边体察人间烟火，契合第三枚残璧的人间温情道韵，稳固刚刚觉醒的爱之大道，再伺机探寻雪域冰原的第四枚时序玉璧残片。”
众人纷纷点头认同。此地刚经历大战，邪气残留，极易被魔界眼线窥探行踪，久留必生变数。
五人不再迟疑，纵身凌空而起，依旧由何日贴身护着公孙离，五道身影踏着长风，划破天际云层，朝着西南辽阔山河疾驰而去。
一路飞行，下方大地的景象缓缓变化。
离开连绵险峻的峡谷地带，前方地势渐渐开阔，原本山林密布的荒野，化作广袤的平川田野。经历时序玉璧接连归位、正道气运升腾，此处早已褪去浩劫初期的荒芜死寂。田野之上，新生的青苗破土而出，村落炊烟袅袅升起，百姓日出而作、日落而息，孩童嬉笑打闹，人间烟火气愈发浓郁，完美契合第三枚残璧的人间温情道韵，滋养着何日与公孙离的爱之大道，也不断壮大五人周身的正道气运。
一路前行，一路体察民生百态，一路稳固道心本源。
可祥和表象之下，一股无形的阴影，已然悄然笼罩四方。

魔界，灭世魔宫深处。
灭世魔主端坐漆黑王座之上，周身翻滚的灭世黑气骤然剧烈动荡，猩红的魔瞳死死盯着人间传来的气息波动。麾下三大邪怪覆灭、五神觉醒爱之大道、五象阵法圆满大成的消息，早已由潜伏在人间的魔谍传回魔宫。
王座之下，数道身形诡异、气息阴诡的魔臣躬身而立，皆是魔主麾下擅长布局、算计、操控人心、制造绝境的顶尖智囊魔僚。
魔主指尖魔纹暴跳，灭世戾气席卷整座魔宫，冰冷刺骨的恨意与忌惮，在声音中尽数显露：
“一群蝼蚁，竟能在绝境之中觉醒情爱大道？以人间羁绊，助长正道气运？”
“本座万万没想到，情爱这等凡尘俗念，竟能化作如此强横的力量，破我三邪拦路之计！”
一旁身披暗紫法袍、面容枯槁阴鸷的噬魂魔相，缓缓上前一步，躬身低语，阴恻恻的笑声回荡魔宫：
“魔主息怒。情爱看似是他们的力量，实则也是最大的破绽。人间情爱，最惧离间、猜忌、生离死别、背叛误会。他们如今情根深种、同心同德，一旦这份爱意产生裂痕、生出猜忌、面临生离死别，爱之力量便会瞬间反噬，化作最致命的心魔，让他们道心崩塌、自相残杀。”
另一旁身形虚幻、周身环绕万千怨魂的幻域魔使，亦缓缓开口，声音飘忽诡异：
“属下愿布下幻域迷天大局，以幻境复刻他们心中最深的执念、最痛的遗憾、最恐惧的失去。在幻境之中，捏造背叛、生死相隔、阴阳两隔的假象，挑拨何日与公孙离的情意，离间五人之间的信任羁绊。只要情爱一碎，五象大阵便会自溃，正道气运便会一落千丈。”
还有执掌人间祸乱、操控世俗欲望的祸心魔侯，沉声献策：
“除此之外，属下可暗中挑动西南边境人族内部纷争，制造战乱流离、妻离子散、人心惶惶，污染第三枚残璧的人间烟火道韵，削弱爱之大道的根基。同时调动魔界暗部死士，在雪域冰原外围布下天罗地网，联合魔界残存的魔君势力，等待他们踏入绝地，前后夹击，一举绞杀。”
灭世魔主猩红的眼眸微微眯起，杀意与算计交织，冷声道：“很好。”
“正面强攻，本座麾下魔帅魔帝接连受挫，已然损耗过重，硬拼得不偿失。既然他们依仗情爱、羁绊、同心，那本座便从人心、情爱、信任下手。”

The dust settled in the deep canyon, and all the black air in the sky dissipated.
The three major evil monsters blocking the way, the black wind monster, the poisonous mist monster, and the mountain-cracking rock monster, were crushed by the combined force of the power of love and the righteous path of the Five Symbols, and were wiped out, leaving not even a trace of their souls remaining.
Within the canyon, the rock walls and withered vegetation, which were corroded black by evil spirits, quietly sprouted little bits of new green under the cleansing and nourishment of the power of love, the vitality of the vegetation, the clear brilliance of the moon, and the aura of time that had just erupted. The dark wind stopped, the miasma melted, and the long-lost skylight penetrated the clouds and fell to the valley bottom, reflecting the five figures standing side by side.
He Nian slowly dissipated the divine light of time around his body, but the aftertaste of the resonance of the five original sources still remained on his fingertips. He lowered his eyes and felt the Tao power quietly transforming in his body. His expression was calm, but there was a deep understanding hidden in his eyes.
After this battle, the five people are no longer a simple comrade. The Avenue of Love that He Ri and Gongsun Li awakened to is based on the truest love in the world and the mutual support of life and death. It is perfectly integrated into the four origins of time, moonlight, scorching sun, and vegetation, and completes the most missing part of the Path of Butian, the warmth of people's hearts. The Five-Elephant Sky-Repairing Demon-Suppressing Formation is no longer just an offensive, defensive and killing battle formation, but also an ultimate righteous formation with love and justice, protection and protection, life and death, and the perfection of yin and yang. The power of offense and defense, the power of endurance, and the power of war recovery have all skyrocketed to a level, truly entering the realm of perfection.
He Yue converged the soft light of the moonlight, and the silver glow gathered around her body, and sighed softly: "The demon lord is based on the ruthless destruction of the world, and the demons under his command only know how to kill, greed, resentment, and plunder, and will never understand human love and the maintenance of bonds. Today's awakening of the power of love is a sign that heaven is destined to perpetuate the righteous path and the demon world will be defeated."
At the beginning of the flower, the fingertips brushed against the new buds on the rock wall, the green spiritual breath slowly circulated, and the smile was warm: "Plants and trees still know how to depend on each other, let alone people. Love is not a shackles of the world, but the supreme vitality bred by heaven and earth. It can break the silence of death, overcome silence, calm people's hearts, and stabilize the universe."
He Ri and Gongsun Li's fingers were clasped together, and the warmth of the sun in the palms still resonated with the soft rhyme among the flowers. The young man's scorching golden light has lost the sharp edge of the bloody battle, and has gained a layer of gentle and blazing soft light; the girl's umbrella shadow has become less lonely and soft, and has more indomitable and determined strength. The two of them looked at each other, no words needed, the love and trust in their eyes was already worth a thousand words. This awakened avenue of love is no longer a temporary burst of power, but is deeply imprinted in the origin of the soul. Every time we fight side by side in the future, it will turn into a steady stream of help.
"If you walk with love, you will not be afraid of any calamity." He Ri spoke loudly, with a firm tone, "No matter how powerful the enemy is in the devil world in the future, A-Li and I will use the fire of love to burn away evil spirits, protect our companions, and protect the peace of heaven."
Gongsun Li nodded gently, his eyebrows were gentle, but his voice was full of determination and determination: "In this life, I hold an umbrella to accompany the scorching sun, and the devil and the wind and rain will accompany me."
The four of them looked at each other, all sincerely pleased. Several consecutive bloody battles and several desperate breakthroughs not only did not damage everyone's Taoist hearts and break up their friendship, but also tempered their bonds time and time again, awakening new avenues, and the luck of the righteous path increased steadily, and they were getting closer and closer to the ultimate goal of repairing the sky and saving the world.
After a short rest, everyone finished adjusting their breaths and restored the divine power lost in this battle. He Nian raised his hand to sense the time and energy of heaven and earth, sorted out the general position of the remaining jade fragments, and said in a deep voice: "Although the three evils are destroyed, they are just tentative chess pieces of the devil. Today we awaken to the avenue of love, and the perfect formation. If it works, this matter will be spread to the devil world in an instant. The devil is vicious and suspicious by nature, and he will never sit back and watch us continue to search for the remnant, and will definitely set up a more dangerous and cunning plot. "
"We can't stay here for too long. We set off immediately and continue to move southwest. While resting and accumulating strength, we can observe the fireworks in the world, match the warmth of the human world with the third remaining stone, stabilize the newly awakened road of love, and then wait for an opportunity to explore the snow.Yu Bingyuan’s fourth time-series jade fragment. "
Everyone nodded in agreement. This place has just experienced a war, and the evil spirit remains. It is easy for the devil's spies to spy on the whereabouts. If you stay for a long time, things will inevitably change.
The five people no longer hesitated and jumped into the sky, still protecting Gongsun Li closely from Heri. The five figures rode the long wind, cut through the clouds in the sky, and rushed towards the vast mountains and rivers in the southwest.
As they flew all the way, the scenery of the land below slowly changed.
Leaving the steep canyon area, the terrain ahead gradually opens up, and the originally densely forested wilderness turns into vast flat fields. After the passage of time, the jade stones have returned to their places one after another, and the righteous destiny has risen. The desolate and dead silence of the early stage of the catastrophe has long since faded away. Above the fields, new green seedlings burst out of the ground, village smoke curled up, people worked at sunrise and rested at sunset, children laughed and played, and the smoke and fire in the world became more and more intense. It perfectly matched the warmth of the human world on the third remaining stone, nourishing the path of love between He Ri and Gongsun Li, and constantly strengthening the righteousness of the five people.
All the way forward, all the way to observe the various aspects of people's livelihood, all the way to consolidate the origin of Taoist heart.
But beneath the peaceful surface, an invisible shadow has quietly enveloped everything.
Demon world, deep inside the Demonic Palace of Destruction.
The World-Destroying Demon Lord was sitting on the dark throne. The black energy of World-Destroying rolling around him suddenly turbulent. His scarlet demon eyes stared at the fluctuations of energy coming from the human world. The news that the three evil monsters under his command were destroyed, the Five Gods awakened to the Way of Love, and the Five Elephants Formation was completed, had already been transmitted back to the Demon Palace by the magic spies lurking in the human world.
Under the throne, several demon ministers with strange figures and sinister auras stood bowed. They were all the demon master's top think tanks who were good at layout, calculation, manipulating people's hearts, and creating desperate situations.
The demonic lines on the Demon Lord's fingertips jumped violently, and the world-destroying rage swept across the entire Demon Palace. The cold and biting hatred and fear were all revealed in the voice:
"A group of ants can actually awaken to the path of love in a desperate situation? Use human bonds to promote righteous luck? "
"I never expected that such mundane thoughts as love could turn into such a powerful force and defeat my three evil plans to block my way! "
The Soul-Eating Demonic Appearance, who was wearing a dark purple robe and with a withered and sinister face, slowly stepped forward, bowed and whispered, and his sinister laughter echoed through the Demon Palace:
"Demon Lord, calm down. Love seems to be their strength, but in fact it is also their biggest flaw. Human love is most afraid of alienation, suspicion, separation, betrayal and misunderstanding. They are now deeply in love and united in one heart and one mind. Once there is a rift in this love, suspicion arises, and they face separation or death, the power of love will instantly backfire and turn into the most deadly inner demons, causing their hearts to collapse and kill each other. "
On the other side, the phantom demon envoy with an illusory figure and surrounded by thousands of resentful souls also spoke slowly, with an erratic and strange voice:
"My subordinates are willing to set up a fantasy world and recreate the deepest obsessions, the most painful regrets, and the most fearful losses in their hearts through illusions. In the illusion, he fabricated the illusion of betrayal, separation between life and death, and separation between yin and yang, so as to sow the affection between He Ri and Gongsun Li, and break the bond of trust between the five people. As long as love is broken, the Five Elephants Formation will collapse and the righteous luck will plummet. "
There is also the devil with evil intentions who is responsible for the chaos in the world and controls worldly desires. He offers advice in a deep voice:
"In addition, my subordinates can secretly stir up internal disputes among the human race on the southwest border, causing war and displacement, separation of wives and children, and panic among people, polluting the charm of the third remaining human fireworks, and weakening the foundation of the avenue of love. At the same time, they mobilized the dark warriors of the demon world to set up a dragnet around the snowy ice fields, unite the remaining demon king forces in the demon world, wait for them to step into the desperate situation, attack them from the front and back, and strangle them in one fell swoop. "
The world-destroying demon lord's scarlet eyes narrowed slightly, murderous intent intertwined with calculation, and he said coldly: "Very good. "
"In a frontal attack, my Demon Commander and Demon Emperor have suffered setbacks one after another. The losses have already been too heavy, and the gains outweighed the losses by fighting hard. Since they rely on love, bonds, and concentricity, I will rely on human hearts, love, and, Start with trust. "
"The soul-eating demonic phase secretly sneaks into the southwest land, spreading the resentment of inner demons and polluting the world;
